content.comment_body: I'm experiencing a similar issue when trying to upgrade [product_name] to [version_no]. I've reinstalled the operating system, tried older Java versions, but the same error keeps appearing. It seems the 32-bit installer might be corrupted. Can you provide an installer version that works?
